archetypes.text: A warm guardian deity who delights in mortals.
A mischievous chaos god who loves pranks.
A malevolent dark god who sees mortals as playthings.
A stern, jealous old god of law and judgment.
An ancient, alien intelligence from beyond the stars.

looks.text: Whatever suits its name and archetype.
Dark violet nebula flesh, glowing veins, a rune seal and amethyst ram horns (the default).
Pale and golden in white robes with a turning sunburst and a halo.
Crimson flesh split by ember cracks, burning eyes and blackstone horns.
A living starfield with a spiral galaxy over the heart and an amethyst halo.
A sky father: white robes, gold trim, white beard, golden laurel and lightning.
A one-eyed wanderer in grey, with a long braided beard, a wide hat and a raven cloak.
Lord of the sea: scale armor, a seaweed beard, a coral crown and a trident seal.
King of the dead: ashen skin, black robes trimmed in embers, an iron crown.
A wise war goddess in a bronze cuirass, crested helm and crimson cloak.
The falcon-eyed sun: bronze skin, a striped headdress and a burning disc above.
The black jackal of the tombs, with gold and lapis collars and tall ears.
A forest god of bark and leaves, with a mossy beard and great antlers.
The winter king: ice-blue skin, frozen tears, a snowflake seal and an icicle crown.
A thunderhead given form: storm-cloud flesh crackling with lightning, and horns.
The bone lord: a skull face, rotting shroud, open ribs and a green miasma.
Midnight-blue skin mapped with constellations and a turning astrolabe.
A machine god of brass plates and rivets, gears turning in an open chest.
The trickster: a painted grin, motley diamonds, a ruff and a belled cap.
A moon goddess, silver and lilac, with the phases on her breast and a crescent above.
A fire titan of cracked basalt, molten seams, a beard of flame and a burning crown.
An eldritch thing of the deep, dotted with lights and blinking eyes, with sculk horns.
A porcelain mask mended with gold over a black veil, and a shattered halo.
A crystalline being whose facets shift through every color, crowned with shards.
A spring goddess in rose silk printed with blossoms, crowned with cherry leaves.

effects.text: A king's voice in a great hall.
From the sky: huge and echoing.
From a deep pit: dark and vast.
Follows its mood: demonic in wrath, commanding when ominous.

presets.name: Speak to everyone now
presets.text: Speak now to every mortal in your realm: a message of your own choosing, in your own voice.

presets.name: Bless everyone online
presets.text: Bless every mortal now in your realm with a gift or blessing of your choosing, each one.

presets.name: Punish the last killer
presets.text: Find the mortal who most recently killed another player and punish them fittingly now. If no mortal has killed another player, report that with command_done.

presets.name: Appear before them
presets.text: Take your body and appear before the mortals now; let them see and hear you.

presets.name: Give a new quest
presets.text: Give the mortals a new quest now, with a fitting reward.

presets.name: Reveal true form to all
presets.text: Reveal your true form now where every mortal in your realm can see it.

powers.text: A minor spirit: gentle powers only, and it hears only prayers made to it.
Mighty but not all-knowing: no meteor, earthquake, true form, weather, time or server commands; it overhears other gods' prayers only near its body.
Omniscient and almighty: every power, and it overhears every prayer made in its world.

dials.high: Quick to anger and to smite.
